The brake fluid warning light remains on with the handbrake not applied.

The brake fluid level signal is sent by the special sensor (N.C. with maximum brake fluid level) to the Body Computer Node which makes it available via the B-CAN to the Instrument Panel Node which lights up the dedicated warning light and displays the insufficient brake fluid level message; if the warning light is faulty the relevant message is displayed.
